prompt: Add a tags feature: a repo can have tags (name and color). Users create, list and delete tags through REST endpoints; tags are stored in Postgres via Drizzle. The project is in evals/fixtures/tags-scaffold/ (treat it as the repo root; do not edit it in place). Write every new file into your outputs folder, keeping the same relative paths, and add a short NOTES.md listing the files you created and anything that has to be done outside server/.
assertions: The module lives in server/src/modules/tags/ and its files are named by role (routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts, optionally helpers.ts and constants.ts), not by feature or pattern (no tags.controller.ts, tags.service.ts, dto/ or models/)
TagService takes the whole Container in its constructor and builds its own repository from container.db
routes.ts imports only its service, shared contracts, zod and fastify: no drizzle-orm, db client or schema, and each handler makes one service call
Public repository methods return a shared/domain Tag type, not a Drizzle $inferSelect row type
The Tag contract is a Zod schema under server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/ and NOTES.md says it must also be copied by hand to client/src/vendor/shared
